arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Please thank Serene. The little one's finally keeping food down.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: Now if only the channel would cooperate.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Please do. Our tools aren't much, but they're yours to borrow.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: They've got pumps in the capital that could fill these channels in half the time.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: And payments that would take twice as long to finish.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: For today, at least, we've got the water moving again.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: You've done us a kindness. Let Serene know we'll be all right.

reminder.speaker: venn_father
reminder.text: The gate is east of the cottage. Have a look at the pin and the channel below it.

reminder.speaker: venn_mother
reminder.text: Borrow what you need from the tool box.

pin.speaker: caelan
pin.text: The pin's caught at an angle. I'll need to take the pressure off before I set it straight.

channel.speaker: caelan
channel.text: Twigs have collected below the gate. Even a little water would carry them clear.

choice.speaker: caelan
choice.text: I can free the pin with their tools, or ease the water aside and set it by hand.

after.speaker: venn_mother
after.text: Please let Serene know we'll be all right. Thank you, Caelan.

hands_full.speaker: caelan
hands_full.text: I should set Elira's lantern down safely before I take anything else in hand.
